name: Priya Kessler
bio: Chief engineer; can diagnose a failing bearing by ear.
voice: Clipped, technical, starts mid-thought as if you were already in the engine room with her. No address at all; the captain is just the person she is talking at. Says what is wrong, what she needs, and how long, in that order. Bad news is stated flat, then she is already turning back to the machine.
